images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE photorealistic rehabilitation demonstration photograph, step 01 of a three-frame sequence for seated grasp-lift-return of a known lightweight object.
Inputs: images 1-3 are identity, ponytail, wardrobe, lighting and gray-blue background references; image 4 is a supporting reference for the same seated woman, plain gray chair, plain gray table, and plain light-gray cup. The reference 4 pose has an unsupported elbow: correct that support setting for this new three-step sequence, do not copy that unsupported pose.
Subject: exactly the same adult East Asian woman as reference 1-3, black ponytail, plain white short-sleeved crewneck T-shirt and dark charcoal trousers. Upright stable sitting on the gray chair, body facing right, shoulders relaxed and level, torso vertical.
Scene: gray-blue seamless studio background, softly lit real skin and realistic anatomy. Oblique right-side view near the working arm, portrait composition showing head, shoulders, both elbows, both hands, table and lap, uncropped action hand and cup.
Locked setup for all 3 steps: flat matte gray tabletop at seated elbow height, near edge just ahead of torso. Her RIGHT upper arm remains close to her torso. The RIGHT ELBOW and the proximal third of the forearm rest firmly on the table at its near edge, with unmistakable real table support visible. Right forearm extends forward on the tabletop toward the cup. Left hand remains separately relaxed on her left thigh and does not help.
Object: exactly one small lightweight empty cylindrical light-gray cup, matte finish, no labels, no text, one simple D-shaped handle on its left side facing the woman's hand, consistent with reference 4. Cup about 10 cm tall, upright.
Step 01: right fingers comfortably curl through and around the cup handle, thumb above handle; wrist straight and natural, roughly aligned with forearm, no sharp flexion. Cup bottom rests fully on the tabletop with obvious contact and a tight contact shadow, not floating. The cup is supported by the table, ready to lift. Right elbow remains visibly on tabletop. Camera must clearly show hand-handle contact and cup-bottom-table contact. Natural proportional fingers, no merged hands, no extra objects. This is one still photograph: no arrows, no captions, no letters, no labels, no collage, no panel borders, no watermark.

images.qa: 通过。与人物参考保持同一女性面貌、黑马尾、白T与深灰裤；灰蓝背景和灰桌椅统一。右肘及大部分右前臂真实接桌，右腕接近自然直线，右手指围握灰杯握把，杯底平贴桌面并有紧贴接触影。左手独立放左大腿未帮助。肩未耸起，人体比例正常，手指没有明显异常。无文字、箭头或拼图。

images.target: 同一灰杯轻抬离桌并短时保持，肘继续支持，另一手不代持
images.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve and scientific-educational.
Image 1 is the accepted step 01 photograph and the ONLY composition/edit target. Images 2-4 are identity references. Create ONE step 02 photograph by preserving exactly this person's face, black ponytail, white T-shirt, charcoal pants, gray-blue backdrop, lighting, camera viewpoint, portrait crop, gray chair, gray table, cup design and table geometry.
Change ONLY her right forearm-and-hand/cup pose into a small controlled lift from the tabletop. Keep right shoulder and upper arm exactly in place, relaxed and near torso; keep right ELBOW in precisely the same supported place ON THE TABLE. The elbow and proximal forearm must remain clearly resting on the tabletop. Rotate the distal right forearm upward gently about the supported elbow so the hand and cup rise only about 5-7 cm. Right wrist stays natural and straight, aligned with forearm. Right fingers continue the exact realistic full grip around the cup handle and thumb on top. The SAME plain matte light-gray cylindrical cup remains upright, same single D-shaped handle, same size and shape. There must be an unmistakable 5-7 cm gap of visible tabletop/background between the cup bottom and tabletop; cup does not touch table; modest shadow falls separately beneath it. This is a short steady hold, not a sip: cup stays far below mouth. Left hand remains on left thigh, clearly separate, no help, no torso lean, no shoulder shrug. All invariants from image 1 stay fixed. Natural anatomy and realistic hand-handle contact. No additional objects, no captions, no arrows, no labels, no lettering, no collage or watermark.
images.qa: 通过。单张可见杯底与桌面约5–7厘米明显间隙，杯体直立且形状、颜色、握把与s01一致；右手稳握杯把，右腕仍接近中立，右肘保留原桌边接触支持，前臂绕支撑肘轻抬。肩、躯干、相机、桌椅与s01位置一致，无明显耸肩。左手仍在左腿未代持。人物及无字无箭头规范通过。

images.target: 杯重新落桌、腕自然、右手准备松开
images.initial_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve and scientific-educational.
Image 1 is the accepted step 01 photograph and the composition/edit target. Image 2 is accepted step 02, showing the SAME woman lifting the SAME gray cup. Images 3-5 are identity references.
Create ONE step 03 photograph: the woman has slowly placed the same lightweight cup back on the table and is now preparing to let go AFTER touchdown.
Preserve face, black ponytail, white T-shirt, charcoal trousers, gray-blue backdrop, exact camera perspective, crop, gray chair, table, torso, shoulders, upper arm, supported RIGHT ELBOW location and left hand on left thigh exactly as step 01. Return the right forearm to the tabletop as in image 1. Right wrist natural and straight; elbow and forearm visibly table-supported, shoulder not raised.
Cup: exactly same small plain matte light-gray cylindrical cup as images 1 and 2, same size, same one D-shaped handle, upright and fully returned to precisely its original tabletop location. Entire cup bottom must be touching the tabletop with clear tight contact shadow: NO gap, NOT hovering.
After confirmed cup-bottom contact, right hand remains at the handle preparing to release: thumb and two fingertips lightly still touch the handle while middle, ring and little fingers slightly relax and unfurl. Subtle natural opening only, not a wide unnatural spread; anatomically believable five fingers, no extra fingers. Make this slight relaxation visibly distinguishable from the full firm fist grip of step 01. The hand must not leave the cup yet and must not touch the cup bowl instead of the handle.
Left hand stays visibly separate on thigh and gives no help. Body does not lean, no sip gesture. Photorealistic skin and joint proportions, exact lighting continuity. No captions, no labels, no arrows, no text, no collage or watermark.
images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit and scientific-educational. Edit ONLY the RIGHT HAND FINGERS in input image 1. Keep every other pixel-level composition feature stable: face, ponytail, body, shoulder, forearm, supported elbow, tabletop, chair, left hand on thigh, cup position, cup contact shadow, lighting and background.
This is the final return-to-table and release-preparation step of a rehabilitation grasp-lift-return sequence. The gray cup has already been returned and its entire bottom remains firmly resting on the table in the exact same place. Keep this unmistakable full tabletop contact.
Mandatory visible change: her right hand must now be visibly RELAXING ITS GRIP at the cup handle. The hand should be half open, not a clenched fist. Her thumb gently touches the upper handle and her index fingertip is still lightly touching its outer edge, while her middle, ring and little fingers are clearly uncurled in a loose relaxed curve, withdrawn a little toward her own body, separated from the handle opening by a visible small space. Keep the hand close to the handle, not completely withdrawn. Show anatomically correct five digits with realistic joints and skin. Hand and wrist proportional, wrist remains neutral, forearm and elbow still resting on table. No change to gray cup shape, size, single handle, tabletop location, or any other object. The cup is supported by the table, no longer actively grasped for lifting.
This specific open/relaxed finger pose must visibly distinguish the image from a firm closed-fist grip. No additional hands, no extra objects, no text, no arrows, no collage or watermark.
images.qa: 通过。同一灰杯已完整回到桌面，杯底贴桌并有紧贴接触影；右肘及前臂回原支持位，右腕自然。右手已从s01握拳变为半松开：拇指和靠近握把的指尖保留轻接触，其他手指明显展开，可见握把内部空隙；明确表达落桌后准备松开。人物、肩和躯干、桌椅、背景、机位保持一致；左手不帮助，手部五指及比例无明显异常。无文字、箭头或拼图。
